members.name: set_dbus_properties
members.note: the application id reaches window rules; the menu, window and application object paths and the unique bus name are accepted and not used

members.name: set_modal
members.note: recorded by the protocol object; gnoblin-wm has no kind-change event, so the parent is not blocked yet

members.name: unset_modal
members.note: recorded by the protocol object; nothing was blocked, so nothing is released

members.name: present
members.note: honoured for the client that already holds keyboard focus, which is the only trusted context the protocol offers; an unfocused window's request is refused as `activation-denied: no-authority`

members.name: request_focus
members.note: the same rule as present; an unfocused request is refused and no attention state is recorded, because gnoblin-wm has none

members.name: titlebar_gesture
members.note: resolved through window_management.action_double_click_titlebar, action_middle_click_titlebar and action_right_click_titlebar; toggle-maximize, minimize and lower are performed, while the horizontal and vertical maximise and the window menu have no gnoblin-wm event and are logged as unavailable

members.name: set_a11y_properties
members.reason: the accessibility tree is not published over AT-SPI yet, so an object path would name nothing

members.name: configure
members.reason: the tiled states and edge constraints are not sent: gnoblin-wm computes geometry from its own state and the adapter has no change hook to announce it

members.name: configure_edges
members.reason: same reason as configure: nothing publishes edge constraints to the adapter

members.name: set_startup_id
members.note: recorded in the session log; there is no startup-notification sequence table to complete

members.name: notify_launch
members.note: logged and attributed to nothing: no startup-notification sequence table yet, so nothing is completed by it
